newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Fil-Estate rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Fil-Estate rated a buy.

text.p: Urbancorp Securities Inc recommended a buy on property developer Fil-Estate Land Inc on Friday due to its strong long-term earnings potential.

Fil-Estate reported a 131 percent growth in its net income to 1.81 billion pesos for the fiscal year ending September 1996. However, Urbancorp said it was expecting a slowdown this year after the hefty jump.

"Sales of the company are expected to slow down this year given its phenomenal 1995/1996 growth before picking up again in 1998. The volume of projects underway cannot continue at the recent breakneck speed and must take a breather," Urbancorp said in its study.

Nevertheless, Urbancorp said the company is likely to post a 27 percent net income growth this fiscal year. Its 40,000 strong marketing force and aggressive in-house financing schemes should provide ample support to its several real estate projects.
"Its net assets value, currently estimated at over 40 pesos, also offer a huge discount," the study added. Fil-Estate closed at 22.50 pesos on Thursday.
